author: TeIq
content: PR 1 landed. SigningError::{WouldBlock, PhysicalPresenceTimeout, TokenDisconnected} additive variants. 3 new Display-shape tests on top of 31 pre-existing signer tests (34 total). Existing v1 impls never construct the new variants — verified by the test suite's complete pass-through. PRs 2-10 of M5 #49 now have the foundation they need.
